host_bound_ab_resolution.question: host-vs-GPU bound (the PN4 checkpoint asked for a complete-wall A/B before investing in a host refactor)
host_bound_ab_resolution.experiment: scripts/pn4_host_bound_ab_probe.py monkeypatches launch_gguf_linear with a memoized fast path that skips the cache-key construction, _resolve_use_* env reads, session gets, and _DISPATCH_RESOLVE_CACHE lookup on cache hit, jumping straight to the launch tail with a cached (abi, fn, quant, variant)
host_bound_ab_resolution.result: complete-wall (sync'd eager decode, 32 steps): OFF 30.59 ms/token, ON 29.73 ms/token, delta -857 us/token (-2.8%)
host_bound_ab_resolution.coverage: fast path fired 4400 of 5781 launch_gguf_linear calls (the ~180/token MoE-expert + per-layer linears); pair/triple launchers have separate launch tails and were NOT fast-pathed
host_bound_ab_resolution.conclusion: the model is ~94% GPU-bound (wall tracks only ~12% of host-dispatch reduction; extrapolated total host-optimization ceiling ~1.8 ms/token or ~6%). A large gguf_linear.py launch-memoization refactor is NOT worth it. The GPU-side P3-LAQ1-B was the correct mechanism family to attempt.

leaf_ceiling.bw_gap: kernel at ~510-540 GB/s effective vs ~650 GB/s marginal L2 ceiling for the tile-read pattern (size-scaling probe: 26.7MB/52us, 13.4MB/31us, 6.7MB/21us, 3.3MB/17us => ~12us fixed + ~650 GB/s marginal)
leaf_ceiling.latency_bound: kernel is latency/occupancy-bound; one block per 16-col tile (768 blocks) with a per-block wave reduce + xchg + syncthreads

variants_tested.description: committed exact Q8_0 t16 dual GEMV owner (128 threads, 4 waves, byte-scattered d/q loads)
T0 variant: d[16] fp16 as 2x uint64 + q[16] int8 as 4x uint32 word loads, identical per-lane K ownership / FMA order / wave tree / BF16 rounding
variants_tested.result: ~5% (within noise); kernel is NOT load-instruction-bound (matches the Q4_K vecq finding)
~9% (best single run, not reproduced on re-measure)

variants_tested.description: process two k-blocks per iteration to double outstanding loads
variants_tested.result: interleaved A/B vs owner: 60.0 vs 62.0 us/layer, delta -1.9 us (~3%, within run-to-run clock noise)
slower AND not bit-exact (different reduction tree) -> not usable

red_state.bit_exact_guard: PASS for all retained T0 variants (wordload/occ/ilp outputs == owner outputs)
red_state.perf_ceilings: NOT FLIPPED: best T0 variant 58-62 us/layer vs ~60 us/layer owner; target 42-48 us/layer (20-30% reduction) unreachable by bit-exact T0 variants
red_state.conclusion: the Q8_0 t16 dual GEMV is at its practical limit for T0 bit-exact variants, matching the Q4_K T16 precedent (P3-LAQ1: vecq -10%, tile16 +5/-7%)

disposition: candidate kernels/launchers/exports/wrappers/registrations reverted to committed state; owner remains default. No T0 variant flips the leaf RED; the qkv_gate stage stays kernel-bound at ~2.29 ms/token. The plan's P3-LAQ1-B section is marked rejected.

c1_campaign_no_win.recurrence_noop_probe: scripts/pn4_recurrence_ab_probe.py: no-opping conv+recurrent launches drops the sync'd eager wall 30.86 -> 28.41 ms/token (-2.44 ms/token): the gdn_attention_core conv+recurrence kernels are a real ~2.4 ms/token GPU-bound slice, not the 5.19 ms marker wall (overlaps other stages) and not the 0.67-1.2 ms burst leaf (understates in-context time)
c1_campaign_no_win.recurrence_fastpath_ab: scripts/pn4_recurrence_fastpath_ab.py: caching the resolved fn+argtypes for the conv+recurrent launchers (skipping per-call build/getattr/argtypes-reassignment) gives ~0 wall change (interleaved medians 30.46 vs 30.48 ms/token): the recurrence host dispatch is fully hidden by other GPU work
c1_campaign_no_win.host_memoization_ab: scripts/pn4_host_bound_ab_probe.py: fast-pathing launch_gguf_linear recovers only ~857 us/token from ~6.8 ms of host reduction -> model ~94% GPU-bound
c1_campaign_no_win.verdict: no retainable c1 mechanism: GEMV T0 families at practical limit (P3-LAQ1 Q4, P3-LAQ1-B Q8), host mechanisms A/B-neutral, model ~94% GPU-bound. Next dominant owner: the MoE expert / router GPU path (cN/A4 campaign), not a c1 GEMV or host mechanism
